scope: Interpretation of HEp-2 indirect immunofluorescence (ANA) patterns. Not a full ENA, ANCA, RF, and anti-CCP manual.

keyRecommendations.text: The HEp-2 IIFA test provides titre or fluorescence intensity and a pattern, not only a positive or negative result.
ICAP presents consensus on the clinical relevance of 29 patterns, defined in the context of the suspected disease, including recommendations for follow-up testing.
Antibody level, judged by titration or fluorescence intensity, has general concordance with clinical relevance.

clinicalBottomLine: Read an ANA as a level plus a pattern, and use the pattern to decide follow-up testing in the disease being suspected. This source does not grade ANCA, RF, or anti-CCP.
notableCaveats: ANCA, rheumatoid factor, and anti-CCP utility are not in this paper and are not questioned.
